source: Qi et al., Applied Thermal Engineering 227 (2023) 120361
method: Manual visual reading of experimental markers; rounded. Endpoints from text. The enlarged error-bar illustration around 128 K is NOT a data point.
temperature_node: Reference silicon chip thermometer; NOT refrigerant temperature
capacity_definition: Additional steady-state electrical heater load in the reference experiment, after its existing parasitic loads

conditions.insulation: Three-layer reference insulation, fitted effective emissivity 0.15

domain: Increasing low-temperature branch only, 88.5 to 153 K; no extrapolation

approximate_reading_tolerance.meaning: Conservative visual-reading allowance, not a statistical confidence interval; near-vertical low-temperature branch is especially sensitive
